1934, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 276 Nov. 29 Lawrence - 5 - Rupture
29 Edw'd Collins - 12 - cripple for 9 yrs. from blood cancer. . ... Hele Jowanack - 15 - spine trouble
Roger LeForge - 2% - one of triplets prayed for in August - now walking but mentally not normal - fear that he was hurt at birth - his two little brothers are just fine, Deo Gr.
Nov. 30 Grace .... wayward girl i.e. against parents with keeping company with boy without religion. .. Mother phones at 10:30 P.M. "Apendi- citis operation To-night.
Sarah Glynn - 27 - Kidney trouble
1934, December
Dec. Mrs. Dorothy Zaworski - 73 - Eye trouble
Dec. 8 Mrs. Marg. McConnl1 - 37 - tuomer on breast - Drs. want to ampu- tate - Enrolled To-day 50c - Has 5 small children.
Page 277
Dec. 10 James McDermott in dying condition - away from H. sacraments many years, refuses to see priest - Enrolled at 3:15 .... Dec. 12 Re- ported To-day as having asked for priest at same time of enrollment. Deo Gr!
Page 278
Dec. Chas. Sweeney - See Nov. 8
9
Wellwood - Bernard Dec. 9 extremely nervous
1] Jane Grabowski - 16 - operation on apendix ... To-morrow.
12 Ed. J. Kean - 62 - Tubercular maningitis - Drs. draining spine every day - "without hope" - made his First Holy Communion last week in hospital.
12 Donald Havar - 2 - operated on this a.m. - piece of glass in eye; loss of sight feared.
12 Mrs. A. Ernst of Richmond, Mich. - Very ill - mother of 7 small children.
Mrs. J. Hughes - 55 - Eyes - Glycoma - improving - Thanks.
